# B2 vocabulary batch 99

Added 25 manually authored B2 entries: `jeopardise`, `labourer`, `loosely`, `lousy`, `lowland`,
`lush`, `luxurious`, `madam`, `madame`, `madness`, `maestro`, `magnify`, `malady`, `malaria`,
`mama`, `manipulate`, `mansion`, `manufacturing`, `marathon`, `marketing`, `massacre`, `masseur`,
`mathematical`, `mausoleum`, and `mediocre`.

Each row was checked for meaning, part of speech, IPA, level, controlled topics, and original
English/Vietnamese examples. Sensitive or derogatory candidates such as `gook` and `cripple` were
not promoted into lesson content.
